q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a baby diaper?
title: Baby diaper carbon footprint per piece
short: Weigh the fluff pulp, superabsorbent polymer, non-woven sheets, film and elastics per diaper and multiply each by its supplier figure. Add the converting line's electricity and packing, then divide by diapers packed.
audience: Diaper makers and private label brands

ul: Non-woven top sheet and back sheet film.

p: Report per diaper by size, since a larger size carries more pulp and polymer.

example.title: Worked example: baby diaper unit per piece (one month)
lines: Plant total: 42,600 / 5,000,000 = 0.00852 kg CO2 per piece
Add pulp, polymer and sheets for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
